common.tenant_and_actor: server authentication context; never accepted from model/public body
common.database_timeout: proposed maxCommitTimeMS5000, total command transaction retry budget10000ms; unknown commit reconciles receipt
common.transport: HTTP paths are implementation-local; operation names are Kiara contracts, not vendor API methods

commands.input: trusted source signup fields only; tenant/actor derived
commands.output: accepted event_id/workflow_id/state=queued; duplicate returns original IDs
commands.reads_writes_and_effects: customers/context; events; workflow; document queue ticket; jobs; command receipt
commands.timeout_retry: short DB transaction, no model call; retry only same command hash
commands.errors: 400 BAD_EVENT; 409 IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED; stale source version auditable no-op

commands.input: due state/time; eligible workflow; worker identity
commands.preconditions: expected workflow state_version and server lease deadline
commands.timeout_retry: 120s lease; 30s heartbeat; no blind completion after expiry

commands.input: job/lease_epoch; expected state_version; typed candidate output refs
commands.reads_writes_and_effects: workflow; job expected version; immutable artifacts; events; next jobs; outbox
commands.preconditions: state, lease, active proposal slot and relevant material guard epochs
commands.timeout_retry: all database effects in one transaction; model/network outside callback

commands.reads_writes_and_effects: feedback + event + command receipt; optional separately typed candidate context/harness task
commands.idempotency: caller-scoped command key + immutable request hash
commands.preconditions: expected state_version; packet match when supplied
commands.timeout_retry: no model call in transaction; text is untrusted data

commands.output: action_id; workflow state/state_version; event IDs; queued notification ID if approval
commands.reads_writes_and_effects: review activity/decision; guard/head touches; workflow; events; jobs/outbox; receipt
commands.idempotency: same key/hash returns original response after rechecking actor access
commands.preconditions: action-specific state; exact bundle/base; fresh epochs+source deadline; founder predecessor for lawyer
commands.timeout_retry: single short transaction; 409 does not auto-approve a refreshed packet

commands.caller_and_kind: trusted worker only; no human/model endpoint
commands.reads_writes_and_effects: tenant/head guard; workflow; finalized event; slot release; finalization outbox; job success
commands.idempotency: one finalization per workflow/bundle; stable job receipt
commands.preconditions: both active approvals same bundle; source deadline; base and slot current
commands.timeout_retry: DB transaction only; notification send separate

commands.input: old workflow_id/state_version; existing replacement workflow_id; reason; idempotency_key
commands.reads_writes_and_effects: workflow; proposal supersession; historical approval invalidation; fenced jobs; pending outbox cancellation; slot transfer/release
commands.preconditions: old workflow nonterminal; replacement same tenant/document and retains trigger provenance
commands.timeout_retry: single transaction; never silently merges business events

commands.input: kind; authorized recipient; immutable bundle/revision; mode; template/payload hash
commands.reads_writes_and_effects: notification_outbox + event in originating state transition transaction
commands.idempotency: unique intent tuple; stable provider key
commands.preconditions: lawyer request requires founder gate; final notice requires finalized workflow

commands.input: fenced outbox row with immutable key/payload
commands.idempotency: Resend identical key+payload within bounded24h provider window; local23h cutoff
commands.preconditions: mode; due time; lease; active review bundle; attempts/deadline
commands.timeout_retry: 15s HTTP; max5 attempts; no blind replay after23h

commands.input: raw body plus svix signature headers; no user-selected tenant
commands.preconditions: valid signature; provider mapping or signed prebound notification tag; timestamp projection rules
commands.timeout_retry: persist before ack; retry-safe receipt; no model/draft regeneration
commands.errors: 400 INVALID_SIGNATURE; unmapped valid event quarantined with200 only after durable quarantine
